scope: Local diagnostic process-isolation experiment; production runtime and deployed architecture unchanged
cloud_constraint: One Cloud Run service, one container, same image; experimental API/engine subprocesses only

workload.features: three levels, fees/NATR, volatility defense, bootstrap/quote guards, drawdown, outflow, inventory skew, operations reads

limitations: One matched pair per CPU setting; not randomized or repeated statistical comparisons
90s and 180s tests have no separate 300s warmup; they cannot replace mixed/hour gates
No per-request server/SQL/GC traces; original historical p99 trigger remains unassigned
Process isolation leaves PostgreSQL aggregates and the shared container CPU quota unchanged
Memory is cgroup memory.peak, a conservative whole-container upper bound including non-RSS pages
Prototype has fixed 8080 ingress/8081 engine ports and test-only pool partitioning; not a production entrypoint
Prototype stops the entire container on either child death; a production API restart policy remains undecided

native_tests.scope: diagnostic failure exit code, bounded DB admission/cancellation/context and deterministic control priority; Cloud Run packaging

test_assumption_fix: Control priority is dispatch order, not completion order across independently scheduled threads. Priority test now frees exactly one worker; no executor/runtime behavior changed.
initial_setup_failures: Existing harness rejected the custom PID1 command before load; corrected by explicitly selecting its test-wrapper entrypoint.
Second preparation duplicated the /test-assets mount; removed the duplicate before load. Both failed setups cleaned their disposable containers.
exploratory_exit_policy: Initial ad hoc scripts returned completion status rather than latency success. Their recorded budget violations remain failures; the promoted runner returns nonzero on healthy violations and has a native regression check.

supervised_recovery_short.scope: Test-only independent restart prototype; 30s healthy diagnostic and real crash/stall faults, not release or long-memory acceptance
supervised_recovery_short.parent_shutdown_measurement: Exit code 0 and existing harness 9.5s deadline pass; helper did not return its measured duration, so numeric duration was not captured. Fixed for the next run.

supervised_warm_diagnostic.scope: 300s warmup + 900s healthy diagnostic; same budgets, both fail latency. Not release acceptance.

memory.steady_definition: Median samples 6..10 versus final five. RSS in KiB; per-process RSS can double-count shared pages.

supervised_warm_diagnostic.controls: Small native smoke ran during the final warmup minute; none during the 900s healthy window. Warmup minute-1..3 latency cluster predates that native run. No cause is assigned from timing alone.

supervised_trace_first.scope: 300s traced diagnostic. HTTP/load/fault timings valid; API loop-lag fields invalidated by a probe heartbeat race. No causal attribution or release acceptance.
supervised_trace_first.loop_lag_defect: Heartbeat could change between threshold check and event serialization. Red test deliberately delays stack sampling; freeze one beat timestamp per sample. 28 selected tests Green. This is test-only instrumentation, not a runtime/latency fix.
supervised_trace_first.trace_limits: Existing bounded 128 MiB stream/2048-record queue; initial API killed during the fault suite, so no complete initial API writer-loss summary survives. GC timestamps and independent client times do not depend on the faulty lag subtraction.

supervised_trace_corrected.scope: Corrected-probe 300s diagnostic only. Pass does not erase failed preceding 300s/900s untraced windows or close release/continuous-hour acceptance.
supervised_trace_corrected.decision: Independent recovery proven in these local faults. Do not promote until healthy latency is repeatably within budget and final architecture passes lifecycle/continuous-hour memory/image gates. No RAM rejection criterion, no GC-policy change, no unique original p99 attribution.

supervised_warmed_request_trace.scope: 300s warmup / 900s traced supervised diagnostic; both latency gates FAIL; no release acceptance

memory.scope: Twenty samples, not a continuous-hour memory gate

limitations: One extra diagnostic PostgreSQL connection; API worker/pool/SQL instrumentation differs from preceding untraced run.
PG sampler errors are retained; 250ms samples may miss waits. Active samples without wait events do not prove CPU-only execution.
Initial API killed by mandatory fault test has no final sink summary. Zero dropped child spans in retained slow roots does not certify zero sink loss.
GC overlap is partial and does not uniquely attribute the historical p99 spike.

daily_cache_15_short_comparison.refresh_count_scope: WITH scoped AS SQL in retained slow request roots; not a complete loss-certified SQL counter
limitations: Sequential single trials do not establish a statistical speedup or unique cause.
The original TTL5 300s window had a minute memory sampler; this short trial did not. A matched warm/healthy repeat is required.
Initial API has no final sink summary after SIGKILL. Sink loss cannot be assumed zero.
